description: Tag patterns for monorepos whose GitHub 'latest release' is not the catalogued tool. The newest non-draft, non-prerelease release whose tag matches the pattern is scanned.

RustSec/rustsec.reason: The catalog entry is cargo-audit; the repository also releases platforms, cvss, and cargo-lock crates.

cloudquery/cloudquery.reason: The repository releases dozens of plugins; the catalog entry is the CLI.

external-secrets/external-secrets.reason: Helm chart releases share the repository with application releases.
